rows.notes: Entity/observation graph over JSONL. 9 tools; a miss in search means a second hop (open_nodes) or a full read_graph. Its search_nodes matches the whole query as ONE substring — a natural task sentence returns nothing, so it only works if the caller hand-shapes a single keyword.
